# Function Objective: Check whether numbers are in ascending order
# Input parameters : numberList (integer list) the numbers to check
# Function description: Compare every number with the next one and report whether all pairs are in order
# Return Value : boolean true when the list is sorted
# Created By : Programmer A
# Create Date: 2026-09-28
# Revised By:
# Revised Date:
def bln_Is_Sorted(numberList):
    bln_Sorted_So_Far = True
    # compare every number with the next one
    for i_index in range(len(numberList) - 1):
        # check that the pair is in ascending order
        if numberList[i_index] > numberList[i_index + 1]:
            bln_Sorted_So_Far = False
        # else the pair is in order, keep the answer
        else:
            bln_Sorted_So_Far = bln_Sorted_So_Far
    return bln_Sorted_So_Far
